Pro is planned to include AI voice interpretation, mood suggestions and movie, series and game recommendations, plus advanced goals and color customization.
Basic cards, on-device voice commands and mood logging will remain available without Pro. A single category color will also remain free.
AI usage limits and the final plan details will be shown before subscriptions go on sale. This is not an unlimited AI offer.
On Android, payment will be completed through Google Play. You will see the price, billing period and renewal terms before purchasing. You can manage or cancel a Play subscription in Google Play.
An AI subscription does not replace your privacy choices. AI permission remains separate. Your existing cards will not be deleted when a subscription ends.
